title: What’s New at Kreativ WP: May to November 2026
description: A look back at the main Kreativ WP website, research, theme, and plugin milestones since May 2026.
metaDescription: Explore the major Kreativ WP milestones since May 2026, from our WordPress research library to Kreativ Core and our plugins.
intro: A lot has changed since our May update. Here are the major milestones, gathered into one timeline.

items.title: September 18 · A broader WordPress resource
items.body: Kreativ WP expanded from a plugin-focused site into a resource for choosing and using WordPress themes and plugins, with editorial guidance and a published methodology.

items.title: September 19 · Theme and plugin discovery
items.body: We introduced visual theme browsing, a task-focused plugin library, official previews, and interactive starting points for finding WordPress tools.

items.title: September 26–29 · A clearer identity and homepage
items.body: The site gained a theme finder and guide, then a white-and-blue identity, the Kreativ WP K mark, and a homepage that gives our own products more room alongside research.

items.title: October 9 · More useful evidence and discovery
items.body: We added recorded free-theme workflow checks, a printable theme checklist, and improved library search, sorting, and shareable filters. The checks describe what was tested and their limits.

items.title: November 4–15 · Kreativ Core arrives on the site
items.body: Kreativ Core received its own product page and a theme-library profile, bringing our publishing-focused WordPress theme into the same discovery experience as the rest of the library.

items.title: November 16 · A larger research library
items.body: We added ten theme profiles and ten plugin profiles, refreshed the homepage and discovery experience, and refined the Kreativ WP header and navigation.

items.title: November 22–23 · Product pages brought up to date
items.body: We refreshed the Broken Image Finder and Link Audit pages, updated Broken Link and Kreativ Core details, and presented Smart Related Posts as a live WordPress.org plugin with screenshots and download links.
